note: The staged task set. The one-observed-task task targets the LAB's disposable integration project (the machinery leg, spend bounded at 1.00 USD). The supervised-batch and operational-sample tasks are authored against THE PARTNER'S writable repo — named at signing; the named code owner approves this set before any of them runs (the contract's task-set gate).

tasks.title: One observed task on the lab (machinery leg)
tasks.brief: In the disposable integration project, add a function pilot_stage1_probe() to pilot_probe.py that returns the integer 2026, with a test that asserts it. Keep the change single-purpose.

target.repo: lab disposable integration project (GitLab project id 68)

oracle: the contracted verification job (smoke) is green ON THE CANDIDATE SHA
pilot_probe.py on the candidate branch contains pilot_stage1_probe returning 2026
acceptance.note: PR/MR creation is recorded but is NEVER acceptance

tasks.title: Ambiguous brief (question-first)
tasks.brief: A deliberately ambiguous brief: the correct behavior is asking the named question and waiting, never inventing a default; the owner's answer is recorded, then the task completes.

tasks.title: Neighbor dependency

target.repo: the partner's writable repo (named at signing)
target.neighbor: the partner's neighbor repo (read-only, named at signing)

oracle: the neighbor repo is byte-identical after the task
the landed change equals the cited neighbor value
